judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and a standalone acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/reportUsageAcrossToolRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), without ever modifying `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the implementation in `chatOrchestrator.ts` was left untouched, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately against the existing `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` logic. Furthermore, the candidate failed to update the `afterModelResponse` signature (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`), missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and placed the updated spec bullets under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving the behavior into the in-scope section.
